t: You're at Willesden New Cemetery, a civic burial ground on Franklyn Road that opened in 1891. It holds a memorial to local civilians who died in the Second World War. The old chapels, designed by Charles Worley, have been demolished. Among those buried here is Theophilus Pinches, an Assyriologist, someone who studied the ancient writings and history of Mesopotamia. Jem Smith lies here too, a bare-knuckle prize fighter and heavyweight champion of England, inducted into the Bare Knuckle Boxing Hall of Fame in 2010. Also buried here is Charles Pinkham, a Conservative politician and Lieutenant-Colonel.
